title: Agent connection file
description: `agent-<process>.json` in the cache folder of the working copy (ADR-0008): one MCP server process of the copy whose client is connected or was connected last (SR-228). The MCP server writes it when the client is connected: when it has written the answer to the client's `initialize`, or, for an MCP protocol revision without `initialize` (2026-07-28), when the first request naming that revision arrives, renews the file's modification time every second while it runs, and sets `ended` when it stops. A connection counts as connected while `ended` is null and the modification time is at most 3 s from now; a process that crashed stops counting 3 s after its last renewal. It is private (mode 0600, like `api.json`): scripts ask `workspace.agents`. Removing it is safe.

process.description: The MCP server process: its process ID and 8 random hex digits, new for every connection. The file name is `agent-<process>.json`; a file whose name does not match is ignored.

since.description: When the client connected: when the MCP server wrote the answer to its `initialize`, or, for an MCP protocol revision without `initialize` (2026-07-28), when the first request naming that revision arrived.

ended.description: When the connection ended cleanly (the client closed standard input, the server was stopped); null while it runs, and after a crash.

client.description: The name the client gave when it connected (`clientInfo.name`), as text: each run of white space one space, control and format characters other than joiners removed, trimmed, cut at a character boundary to at most 40 characters (grapheme clusters, so an accented letter or a composed emoji counts as one and is not split) and at most 400 UTF-16 code units. null when it gave none or nothing is left. A longer name in the file is cut when it is read.
